summary: A result of kind page with no url is dropped by the panel, never drawn as a row that does nothing; a command carries kind action and no url, and is drawn.

then.note: Of {id: a, kind: page, title, url: /a/}, {id: b, kind: page, title} and {id: theme, kind: action, title} the panel draws a and theme: b is a page it cannot open. A host that means a command writes kind action; a host that forgot the url learns it from the row that is missing, not from a row that swallows the press.
